name: syaocode-desktop-workspace
description: SYAOCode Desktop: Electron shell + DHP host/client/ui

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @syaocode/host run build && pnpm --filter syaocode-desktop run build
scripts.package:dir: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter syaocode-desktop run package:dir
scripts.package:mac: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter syaocode-desktop run package:mac
scripts.package:win: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter syaocode-desktop run package:win
scripts.package:linux: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter syaocode-desktop run package:linux
